caption: The drawing depicts two human figures, one adult and one child, positioned centrally within a rectangular frame against a light brown background. The adult figure is wearing a long blue garment and holds a yellow object resembling a feather or leaf in their right hand. The figure's head is tilted to the left, and they have short, dark hair with a clear facial outline. The child, dressed in a red garment with blue details, is positioned on the adult's left arm and also has short dark hair, and a visibly outlined face turned toward the viewer. The background within the rectangular border is tan or light brown, decorated with numerous red and blue leaf-like or flame-shaped motifs scattered throughout. The entire scene is enclosed in a border with a reddish tint, and the drawing is mounted on a larger, off-white or cream-colored background. There is some handwritten text at the bottom in red and black ink. The overall texture appears slightly rough, with visible brushstrokes and a somewhat faded or aged appearance to the colors.
title: Santos Retablos
